channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: GAA to maintain its association with Allianz after EIC report
item.description: The GAA is set to continue its relationship with Allianz despite calls from a number of county boards to end its association with the insurance group following a report which alleged the company profited from Israeli forces being in Gaza.

item.title: Kilcullen hits 4-10 as Easkey set-up All-Ireland club JHC final date with Kilbrittain
item.description: Kilbrittain (Cork) advanced to the All-Ireland club junior hurling championship final thanks to a 2-15 to 1-16 win over Davidstown-Courtnacuddy (Wexford) in Clonmel this afternoon.

item.title: Second-half goals help Tipp see off Cats in charity SH challenge
item.description: Tipperary saw off Kilkenny by 2-20 to 2-11 in this afternoon's charity challenge match at Templetuohy which was played in aid of Mary's Meals, a charity dedicated to feeding children in some of the world's poorest countries.

item.title: All-Ireland champions Kerry named RTÉ Sport Team of the Year
item.description: All-Ireland senior football champions Kerry were named Team of the Year at last night's RTÉ Sport Awards.

item.title: Burns backs GAA's Allianz sponsorship stance
item.description: GAA president Jarlath Burns has defended the association's Allianz sponsorship stance, saying that to cut ties with the insurance giant could have left it potentially "toxic" to other sponsors.

item.title: Tooreen and Upperchurch-Drombane set-up All-Ireland club IHC final date
item.description: Tooreen (Mayo) and Upperchurch-Drombane (Tipperary) will square off in the All-Ireland club intermediate hurling championship final at Croke Park after both teams came through their respective semi-finals this afternoon.

item.title: Loughrea to sweat over key midfielder's availability for All-Ireland club SHC final
item.description: Galway champions Loughrea are expected to try and get Cullen Killeen's red card overturned ahead of next month's All-Ireland club senior hurling championship final.

item.title: Watch: Goals propel Loughrea past Slaughtneil into All-Ireland club SHC final
item.description: Anthony Burns and Vince Morgan netted the goals as Loughrea defeated Slaughtneil by 2-22 to 0-15 at Parnell Park this afternoon to advance to the All-Ireland club senior hurling championship final for the first time in 19 years.

item.title: Ballygunner deliver in second-half against St Martin's for All-Ireland club SHC final berth
item.description: Ballygunner came good in the second-half to see off St Martin's by 0-19 to 0-10 at Semple Stadium and book their place in next month's All-Ireland club senior hurling championship final against Loughrea.
